item.title: Over 560 schools disrupted in France on Friday as protests escalate into ‘urban violence’ – Europe live
item.description:
Dozens of schools have been damaged and nearly 3,000 teenagers have been detained since the start of the tensions

Back to France, midday figures quoted by Le Figaro show that 564 schools and educational establishments have been disrupted by the ongoing unrest, and some 600 people have been arrested so far today as the high school protests continue.

item.title: Minister denies UK faces diesel shortage after Trump threatens to ban exports
item.description:
In effort to avoid panic at pumps, Keir Mather insists supply of fuel to Britain is ‘inherently resilient’

  • UK diesel price hits record high of £2 a litre

  • Business live – latest updates

The government has sought to avert panic at the pumps, insisting that the UK is not facing a diesel shortage after Donald Trump threatened to cut off US supplies of the fuel.

The transport minister Keir Mather said on Friday that the UK has a wide range of sources of the fuel and is in talks with other European countries over the potential release of emergency diesel stockpiles.
